text: You're stopped at a traffic check, and your licence is at home.
you can show it in electronic form,
in Diji Locker, or the em Puh-ree-vaa-hun app.
Those count like the original papers.
Once an officer verifies it electronically, the paper can't be demanded,
even if there's an offence and documents need seizing.
So add your licence to Diji Locker before you drive.
